findings.note: The two prose mentions of the auto mode are Latin 'auto', while every other mention of that mode in this namespace is Devanagari 'ऑटो' (mode.auto, set_session, set_all, session_saved, default_saved*). The sentence therefore shows 'auto' where the card's own chip reads 'ऑटो'. Latin is defensible only for the typed token in '/approvals auto', which stays verbatim. Not blocking: the bytes are the core repo's own wire.bridge_taint.card_options_off by design, so a fix means changing core text too (ऑटो in the two prose spots, 'Allow all' unchanged); record as a follow-up, no remediation round needed.
